login_intro: Enter the e-mail address or phone number registered with the Association and we will send you a sign-in code.
phone_hint: Choose the country code, then type your number without the leading zero.
code_sent_email: We sent you an e-mail with a sign-in code and a direct link. Enter the code here, or open the link on this device.
code_sent_phone: We sent a sign-in code by text message to your phone.
code_hint: The code has 6 digits and is valid for a short time.
offline_banner: No internet connection. Signing in needs a connection.
notice_revoked: An administrator ended your session on this device. Please sign in again.
notice_session_ended: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
notice_pin_wiped: A wrong PIN was entered {max} times, so the sign-in data stored on this device was deleted. Please sign in again. Your unsent data is still saved on the device.
notice_link_invalid: The sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new code.
error_offline: No internet connection. Check the network and try again.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error_unknown_user: This account is not registered. Contact the Association's administrator to be added.
error_code_invalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Request a new code.
error_invalid_phone: Enter a valid phone number with its country code.
error_account_disabled: This account is suspended. Contact the Association's administrator.
error_sms_failed: The text message could not be sent. Try again or use e-mail.
error_mfa_code_invalid: The verification code is wrong. Check the code shown in your authenticator app.
error_mfa_challenge_expired: The verification timed out. Try again.
error_pin_invalid: The PIN must have {min} to {max} digits.
error_pin_weak: This PIN is too easy to guess. Choose another one.
error_pin_mismatch: The two PINs do not match.
error_no_session: The session has ended. Please sign in again.
error_storage: Could not save on this device. Make sure there is free storage and that the browser is not in private mode.
error_insecure_context: The app only works over a secure connection (https).
pin_setup_intro: This PIN protects your account on this device. You will be asked for it whenever you open the app and after {minutes} minutes without use.
pin_setup_note: If you forget the PIN you can sign in again and choose a new one.
pin_wait: Wait {seconds} s before the next attempt.
pin_forgot: Forgot the PIN? Sign in again
pin_forgot_message: The sign-in data stored on this device will be deleted and you will need to sign in with a new code sent by e-mail or phone (internet connection required). Your unsent data stays on the device.
mfa_enrol_intro: Your account has administrative permissions, so two-step verification is required. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code.
mfa_qr_alt: QR code for adding the account to an authenticator app
mfa_secret_label: Or enter this key manually in the app
mfa_secret_warning: Do not share this key with anyone. It will not be shown again.
mfa_challenge_intro: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
mfa_lost: Lost your authenticator app? Contact the system administrator to reset it.
mfa_load_failed: Could not load the two-step verification settings.
context_offline: No internet connection. A connection is needed once to finish signing in.
context_failed: Could not load your account details.
signout_unsent_title: You have data that has not been uploaded
signout_unsent_message: This device holds data that has not reached the server. Pending changes: {ops}. Pending photos: {photos}. You may lose them if you sign out now. We recommend syncing first.
